message:
I had a little power outage at home the other day, and it got me thinking about our family group chat. You know, the one where we share our clever tips and tricks for everything? It’s amazing how a little darkness can spark creativity! 

I found this great resource from the Red Cross that’s all about prepping for power outages. It’s super helpful for keeping everyone in the loop and making sure we’re all ready for the next time the lights flicker. 

Stay cozy and enjoy the quiet moments, and maybe even share your own favorite blackout tip in the chat! 🌟
